**Profile**

Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience building scalable REST APIs, intelligent ERP systems, and modern React frontends. Proficient in Python (FastAPI, Django, Pydantic), PostgreSQL, and React/TypeScript, with direct exposure to AI feature integration (semantic workflows, Gemini API) in a production ERP startup. Experienced with RBAC, modular backend architectures, and Docker-based deployments. Motivated by complex, evolving technical environments and driven to ship robust, well-structured software.

**Professional Experience**

**Full Stack Software Developer, ** ***Hippomed AI*** 05/2025 – 10/2025

*Tunis, Tunisia · AI-powered healthcare ERP startup*

- Designed and maintained secure REST APIs with Python/Django and Spring Boot, implementing authentication, RBAC, and hierarchical access control for a multi-role ERP platform.
- Optimised PostgreSQL data models and queries for performance and scalability across core ERP modules.
- Built and maintained core frontend interfaces with Angular and Rx JS, translating business requirements into dynamic, responsive UIs.
- Developed internal admin tooling and backend logic with Python/Django, contributing to data validation and module configuration workflows.
- Delivered cross-platform mobile interfaces with React Native (Ionic) for i OS and Android, ensuring consistent UX.
- Contributed to AI feature preparation: participated in architectural discussions around intelligent workflow integration and service automation.
- Participated in Agile ceremonies — sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives — collaborating across frontend, backend, and product profiles.
- Used Git/GitHub for version control; validated APIs with Postman across cross-functional team workflows.

**Full Stack Developer Intern, ** ***Wowsoft*** 07/2024 – 08/2024

*Tataouine, Tunisia*

- Built responsive, production-ready frontends with Next. js and TypeScript, integrating REST APIs with SSR for performant, scalable interfaces.
- Maintained code quality and documentation standards throughout the stack; optimised component structure and data-fetching patterns across devices.

**Projects**

**Task Vortex** *, Real-time collaborative project management tool* 08/2025 – 10/2025

- Architected a scalable Nest JS backend with JWT authentication, RBAC, Redis caching (40% latency reduction), and Bull MQ for background job processing.
- Designed RESTful APIs with end-to-end type safety (Zod/TypeScript); integrated Web Sockets for live collaborative updates across concurrent users.
- Built a responsive React + TypeScript frontend with drag-and-drop task boards, Tan Stack Query for server state, and Docker/Nginx for containerised deployment.
- Tech: React, TypeScript, Nest JS, Zod, Web Sockets, Bull MQ, Redis, MongoDB, Docker, Nginx, JWT

**Skilline** *, Gamified learning platform with AI integration* 03/2025 – 04/2025

- Integrated Gemini API for AI-powered content suggestions, building user-facing intelligent features — direct experience with LLM/AI service integration.
- Built full-stack React + TypeScript application with flashcard flows, leaderboards, and Framer Motion animations; maintained consistent design system with Shad CN UI.
- Tech: React, Next. js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Shad CN UI, Express, Gemini API, Framer Motion

**Prestige Deco** *, Full-stack e-commerce application* 03/2025 – 04/2025

- Delivered a performance-optimised full-stack app with PostgreSQL/MongoDB data models, REST API backend, and responsive Next. js frontend.
- Tech: Next. js, TypeScript, Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Mongoose, Tailwind CSS, Shad CN UI
